narrative.overview:
LinkedOut is stock shadcn on the neutral base, used at its smallest honest size: a name, one line of status, and one control. The world is the user's pinned choice. The popup does not decorate that world; it holds to its tokens and lets the status line carry all the meaning a glance needs.

Density is that of a browser extension popup, opened for a few seconds in the middle of a job search. Hierarchy comes from weight and tone, not from scale or color. Chroma appears only when something has failed, so red always means the same thing.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic shadcn neutrals, with the destructive red as the only hue.
One status line that changes tone, never a second message surface.
A 20rem panel with a height floor that reserves room for the portalled menu.
Flat at rest. Only the open menu lifts.
Light and dark follow the operating system, with no in-product switch.

rules.name: The Three Tones Rule
rules.body: The status line has exactly three tones. Plain ink states what this list is doing. Faded ink is idle guidance when there is no list to act on. Failure red is any failure. There is no success color; a working list reads in plain ink.

rules.name: The Red Means Failed Rule
rules.body: Failure Red is the only chroma on the surface. If a popup element has hue and nothing has failed, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Follow the System Rule
rules.body: `prefers-color-scheme` alone selects the scheme, for the tokens, for the `dark:` variant, and for the native `color-scheme`. There is no class toggle and no in-product switch.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: The panel uses two sizes, 1rem and 0.875rem. Everything else in the hierarchy is weight and tone.

rules.name: The Field Label Rule
rules.body: A label names the control directly beneath it, in sentence case, because the control's value alone would have no verb. It never sits above a heading, and it is never uppercase or tracked out.

rules.name: The Reserved Room Rule
rules.body: The menu is portalled, so it adds nothing to the document's height, and a popup window sized to its content would clip it. The body's height floor exists to hold the open menu. The closed content ends at 10.375rem including bottom padding; the trigger's bottom edge is at 9.375rem, and the menu begins 0.25rem below it. A menu of n rows ends at 9.625rem + 0.5rem + (n × 1.75rem). The 13rem floor holds one row. When rows are added, raise the floor with them.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: Menu rows align to the trigger above them. Row text starts 11px from the shared left edge, as the trigger's text does (trigger: 1px border + 10px padding; row: 4px menu padding + 7px). The check centers on the trigger's chevron, both 16px and both ending 9px from the right edge (trigger: 1px + 8px; row: 4px + 5px). The menu takes the trigger's exact width. Those offsets are set where the menu is used, not in the vendored component.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only what floats over the panel lifts. Anything in the panel's own flow stays flat.

dos: Do read every color from the shadcn custom properties in `entrypoints/popup/style.css`, so both schemes follow without extra work.
Do use the Three Tones as the only status treatments: plain for this list's state, muted for idle guidance, destructive for any failure.
Do add a hideable status as another row in the Hide Menu, then raise the 13rem floor per the Reserved Room Rule.
Do keep status text to one line of the 18rem measure at 0.875rem. "Could not load your choice. Choose again." is near the limit.
Do keep menu rows on the trigger's text and chevron edges, per the Shared Edge Rule.
Do keep browser surfaces on the palette: selection inverts ink and sheet, and the scrollbar thumb uses Hairline on a transparent track.
Do collapse animation and transition durations to 0.01ms under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't add a success color or any new hue. A list that is working reads in plain ink.
Don't use Failure Red on the status line for anything that has not failed.
Don't add a second message surface, such as a banner or toast, alongside the status line.
Don't write raw color values at a call site, or override a token per scheme outside the stylesheet.
Don't add a theme switch or class-based dark mode. The operating system decides.
Don't lift the panel, the trigger, or anything else in the panel's flow with a shadow.
Don't assume the 13rem floor is enough for a longer menu. It holds one row.
